changes.change: EASY FIX: HmacActorProvenanceStore.Configure() now enforces MinimumSecretLength = 32 (matching BIO-INT-003's own ActorProvenanceGate.cs exactly, now Kemi-ruled canonical floor-wide) - a secret shorter than this is treated the same as unconfigured, never retained as a usable-but-weak key.
changes.approver: N/A - direct fix adopting an already-canonical floor-wide pattern, no architecture decision involved
changes.description: Closes the gap where any arbitrarily short, guessable secret would have been accepted and used to compute real HMAC proofs.
changes.regression_tests: New tests/features/bio-bio-009/ActorProvenanceGateTests.cs - a secret one byte under the minimum is rejected even with a correctly-computed proof; exactly-at-minimum is accepted; a proof for a different actor id is still rejected.

changes.change: REAL GAP fix (two parts): (1) IPendingGalleryCleanupStore's real production implementation is now FileBackedPendingGalleryCleanupStore (write-to-temp-then-replace JSON file), registered via PendingGalleryCleanupStoreProvisioning - the pending obligation genuinely survives a process restart. InMemoryPendingGalleryCleanupStore is kept only for this feature's own filesystem-free unit tests. (2) BiometricDeletionService.DeleteAsync's catch block no longer discards the pending-cleanup record unconditionally on any exception from the delete call - it now verifies via the same read-only Resolve*OwnerAsync peek whether the record is CONFIRMED to still exist before discarding; an ambiguous result (record gone, or verification itself fails) leaves the pending record in place.
changes.approver: N/A - direct fix of a required reviewer finding, no cross-story change involved
changes.description: Closes two compounding defects: a process restart previously erased the only recovery record for any still-pending gallery cleanup; and a delete call that actually committed before throwing could previously have its recovery record discarded anyway, stranding a gallery entry with no path back to it at all.
changes.regression_tests: New tests/features/bio-bio-009/FileBackedPendingGalleryCleanupStoreTests.cs (4 tests, two separate store instances over the same file path see each other's writes). New BiometricDeletionServiceTests: a_throw_from_delete_that_turns_out_to_have_actually_deleted_the_record_keeps_the_pending_record, a_throw_from_delete_whose_own_verification_also_fails_keeps_the_pending_record.

changes.change: NOT THIS STORY'S BUG, disclosed per god's explicit instruction rather than fixed unilaterally: web/features/biometrics/live.ts sends no actor identity at all (no X-Actor-Id, no X-Actor-Provenance), so the real backend correctly rejects every LIVE call with 400 actor_required before ActorProvenanceGate is ever reached - the same cross-cutting TD-WEB-PROVENANCE-BRIDGE gap Tunde hit on BIO-TEN-003. New tests/frontend/playwright/bio-bio-009-retention-privacy-live.spec.ts (opt-in, BIOLOG_BIO009_LIVE_TESTS=1) proves this honest claim against two REAL running servers - a LIVE-built Next dev server and a real Biolog.Api host - not merely authored and left unexecuted. Its own beforeAll registers and verifies a real tenant domain through BIO-TEN-002's own control-plane API first, a separate, genuinely pre-existing fact (a fresh host starts with zero tenant domains registered) found while proving this honestly, not a shortcut around this story's own security gate. RetentionSection.tsx also gained real error handling (policyError/deletionError state, role="alert") - a genuine, pre-existing correctness gap in the component itself (an uncaught live-adapter failure previously left the UI stuck loading forever), independent of the disclosure.
changes.approver: god (explicit instruction: disclose as an honest HYBRID boundary, follow Tunde's BIO-TEN-003 precedent, do not invent a bridge)
changes.description: The provenance-bridge gap is foundational, cross-cutting infrastructure (tracked floor-wide, Kemi/Emeka/Damilola) - no browser anywhere in this codebase can satisfy an identity-gated endpoint yet without shipping a shared secret to the browser.
changes.regression_tests: bio-bio-009-retention-privacy-live.spec.ts (2 tests, run for real against two live servers during this round - both passed: 400 actor_required, surfaced via role="alert", no success badge rendered).

summary: Round 4 closes the two genuinely-fixable findings both reviewers converged on after round 3 (302c735): the provenance secret's missing minimum-length floor, and the pending-cleanup store's lack of real durability (both the in-memory-singleton problem and the ambiguous-exception-discards-the-obligation problem). The third finding - the live browser adapter cannot yet satisfy this story's own identity gate - is explicitly disclosed as an honest HYBRID boundary per god's direct instruction, the same TD-WEB-PROVENANCE-BRIDGE gap already escalated floor-wide from BIO-TEN-003; this round proves that disclosure for real against two live running servers rather than asserting it from documentation alone, and in doing so also found and worked around (via test setup, not a story-level fix) a separate pre-existing fact: a fresh host has no tenant domain registered at all, so the actually-observed rejection is 400 actor_required, not 401 actor_provenance_required as first assumed.
